description: The tutorial's 'blocked action' toast must say what WOULD work. It used to echo the step's bark verbatim, so poking the wrong thing on Basic Trainin' step 7 produced 'Oi! Not dat one, ya git — READ DA BAR!' — a non-sequitur that named no way forward. This drives two out-of-scope actions against T1: on the mouse+keyboard welcome step (an ack step with no per-step wording) the default names the card's Continue button with no controller glyph; on the pad-only 'READ DA BAR!' step the step's own blocked_hint is used, rendered with the pad glyph. Neither toast may fall back to shouting the bark.
